- Pattern: Large coalescing dark lesion plus scattered brown spots on yellow peel
- Other bananas: Mostly healthy yellow/green with minor blemishes

**Disease matching:**

| Disease | Fruit symptoms | Match |
|---|---|---|
| **Anthracnose** | Dark, sunken, coalescing lesions on banana peel; spots merge into large black areas | **High** |
| **Cigar End Rot** | Dark rot at blossom tip only (distal end), dry shrunken tip | Partial - extensive spread doesn't fit |
| Cordana/Sigatoka/Panama | Primarily leaf diseases | Low |
| Bunchy Top | Viral, affects whole plant growth | Low |

The scattered brown spots that coalesce into a large dark necrotic area on the banana fruit peel is the hallmark presentation of **Anthracnose** (*Colletotrichum musae*). Cigar End Rot would be confined to the tip/blossom end and show a more "ash-like" dry appearance rather than spreading dark spots.
